question: The moderate margin of a page in MS Word can be applied to the page from which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Page Layout Tab**__.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Page Layout Tab**: This tab in MS Word allows users to set up the page layout, including margins, orientation, size, columns, and more.
 
• Review Tab: This tab is primarily used for proofing, comments, tracking changes, and comparing documents.
 
• Design Tab: This tab focuses on the overall design of the document, including themes, colors, fonts, and effects.
 
• View Tab: This tab allows users to change the view of the document, such as switching between print layout, web layout, outline, and draft views.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• First released on October 25, 1983, as Multi-Tool Word for Xenix systems.
 
• **File Extensions:**
 
• .doc: Used in older versions (Word 97-2003).
 
• .docx: Default format since Word 2007 (Office Open XML).
 
• .dotx: Word template.
 
• .docm: Macro-enabled document.
